title: Dev mode is an explicit opt-in (fail closed); deploy config consistent
story: As the platform operator I want dev mode (token minting, demo personas) on only when explicitly enabled so that a deployment that forgets NODE_ENV is not wide open
acceptance: S6-EXP-02 security gate (medium): devMode = opts.devMode ?? NODE_ENV !== production is fail-open. New rule: devMode is true only when opts.devMode is true or FNOL_DEV_MODE=1; otherwise false regardless of NODE_ENV (test for unset, 0, 1, NODE_ENV values)
npm start (scripts/dev.mjs) sets dev mode for local use so the local experience is unchanged; tests that rely on devMode pass it explicitly
Boot log prints one clear warning line when dev mode is on (no secrets)

Dockerfile, infra/cloudrun/service.yaml and docs/deploy-fnol-poc.md agree: the fnol-poc deploy sets FNOL_DEV_MODE=1 explicitly (IAP-only PoC, accepted R2 risk) and the deploy command in the runbook is updated; the deployment-files test checks the manifest and runbook agree
Full npm test no new failures
brief: src/server.mjs:69-70 computes devMode. Grep tests for devMode/NODE_ENV usages (IMP-14) and include any test that must change in your result; post to the platform hub if a test outside your paths must change. Sequenced after the Wave B redesigns (they edit tests/ui). Test harnesses that rely on the old default are in your paths; set devMode explicitly there.
